title: pack-returns-v1
description: Schema for Worker-written pack-returns/<run_id>/<pack-id>.json files. Source of truth for the JSON envelope produced by pack_executor / complex_pack_executor at the end of a Pack. Read by agent-return-handler hook (per-pack).

pack_id.description: Pack identifier (e.g. '1.1', '2.3'). Must match the Pack ID parsed from the dispatch envelope.

verdict.description: Worker's verdict for this Pack. Drives downstream Coordinator routing (commit / repair / pause / fetch context).

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths of files changed in this Pack. Used by reviewers and final-review to focus diff inspection.

open_items.description: Items the Worker observed but did not resolve within Pack scope. Each entry must carry a tag and a short summary so Coordinator can triage.

tag.description: Triage tag: out-of-scope = outside this pack's responsibility; needs-evaluation = requires independent judgment to decide whether to fix; bug = pre-existing defect surfaced (not introduced by this Pack).

summary.description: Short human-readable description, ideally including 'where found' and 'impact judgment'.

concerns.description: Free-form Worker concerns or caveats reviewers should see. Optional.
